title: NV Ramsey interferometry visualizer export
description: Snapshot of index_ramsey.html's current settings and every derived measurement shown on screen, for external validation against the closed-form physics documented in this repository's README, CLAUDE.md, and verify/. Field/naming conventions follow bell-state-explorer's export schema (dreads/bell-state-explorer schema/bell-state-export.schema.json) where the underlying data lines up, to ease later integration of these visualizers into one tool.

$schema.description: URI of this schema, so validators can dereference it without out-of-band configuration.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this export format, independent of the app's own version.

exportedAt.description: UTC timestamp the export was generated, RFC 3339 / ISO 8601.

tauUs.description: Free-evolution time tau between the two pi/2 pulses, in microseconds (S.tau).

driveFreqGHz.description: Fixed microwave drive frequency, in GHz (S.mw).

t2StarUs.description: Dephasing time T2*, in microseconds, capping the useful tau (S.t2).

vehiclePosition.description: Normalized position of the vehicle along the illustrative terrain route (S.vx); sets the local field via fieldAt(vx).

sequencePosition.description: Normalized position u within the pulse sequence (0=start |0>, ~0.14=after 1st pi/2, ~0.86=end of tau, 1=after 2nd pi/2). Reflects the play/stage-jump state at export time.

blochVector.description: [x, y, z] Bloch vector at sequencePosition u, from the exact RY(pi/2) - free-Z-precession - RY(pi/2) circuit (blochVec(u)).

fieldMt.description: Local magnetic field B at the vehicle's route position, in mT.

detuningMHz.description: Signed detuning of the drive from the Zeeman-shifted resonance f+, in MHz.

detuningRadPerUs.description: Same detuning, in rad/microsecond (delta), as used directly in the phase formula phi = delta*tau.

phaseAtTauRad.description: Total phase banked over the full free-evolution window, phi = delta*tau, in radians -- independent of where the playhead currently sits.

populationAtTau.description: P(tau) = 0.5*(1+cos(delta*tau))*exp(-tau/T2*) + 0.5*(1-exp(-tau/T2*)) -- the readout population at the full tau, matching the fringe plot and P(0) chip.

stage.description: Which stage of the pulse sequence sequencePosition falls in, matching the visible stage badge's text.
